title: Owner Auto Policy Filed Driver Rating Table: Points-Tier Change on Re-Listing
content:
**Points-tier change relativity.** Under the company's filed driver rating, a points-tier change relativity multiplies the share of a household resident listed again on the Owner Auto Policy. The share is multiplied before it is rounded to the cent.

**The points tiers:**

| Tier | Driver violation points | Tier relativity |
|---|---|---|
| high | 10 or more | 1.3 |
| mid | at least 5 and fewer than 10 | 1.12 |
| low | fewer than 5 | 1 |

**Two readings are compared:**
- **Then:** the points on the rating entry, which is the resident's most recent driver-added entry.
- **Now:** the points on the resident's most recent entry on the term.

| Tier then | Tier now | Relativity applied |
|---|---|---|
| low | mid | 1.12 |
| low | high | 1.3 |
| mid | high | 1.3 divided by 1.12 |
| mid | low | 1 divided by 1.12 |
| high | mid | 1.12 divided by 1.3 |
| high | low | 1 divided by 1.3 |
| unchanged | unchanged | 1 |

**Hypothetical sides of the tier lines.**
- Then 4 points, now 5 points: low to mid, so 1.12.
- Then 9 points, now 10 points: mid to high, so 1.3 divided by 1.12.
- Then 6 points, now 8 points: unchanged mid, so 1.
